Everything you have imported so far — `Collections`, `Browser`, `RequestsLibrary`
— is a **Python library**. Now you write one.

When you import a Python module with `Library`, each of its **functions becomes a
keyword**. Robot Framework converts the name: `order_reference` in Python is
`Order Reference` in a suite. Your libraries live in `libraries/`; a suite in
`checks/` imports one with a relative path, `../libraries/<file>.py`.

One wrinkle to know up front: arguments arrive from a suite as **text** unless
you say otherwise. Passing `${42}` sends the integer 42; passing `42` sends the
string `"42"`. (The next lessons make this precise.)

## Task 1 — Write a function Robot Framework can call

**Goal:** create `libraries/shop_tools.py` with a function
`order_reference(prefix, number)` that returns a padded reference like
`TRN-0042`.

Here is the same shape over different data — a warehouse code. Adapt it to build
an order reference (four digits, not three).

<!-- example -->
```python
def warehouse_code(zone, number):
    return f"{zone}-{number:03d}"
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `libraries/shop_tools.py` defines a function `order_reference`.

<!-- hint -->
A module library is just a `.py` file with plain functions — no class, no
imports needed here. Define `def order_reference(prefix, number):`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Build the string with an f-string and zero-padding to four digits:
`return f"{prefix}-{number:04d}"`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```python
def order_reference(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:04d}"
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Import it and run it green

Create `checks/orders.robot` that imports your library and calls the keyword.
Note the `${42}` — it passes the integer 42, which the `:04d` formatting needs.

```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library    ../libraries/shop_tools.py

*** Test Cases ***
Order Reference Is Built
    ${ref}=    Order Reference    TRN    ${42}
    Should Be Equal    ${ref}    TRN-0042
```

Run it:

```bash
uv run robot checks/orders.robot
```

**Check:** the test `Order Reference Is Built` passes.
